TraverseResponse.title: TraverseResponse
TraverseResponse.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection (RFC 7946) with extra top-level members.

wind_gust_ms.title: Wind Gust Ms
wind_gust_ms.description: Perseverance only. 99th percentile of the wind speed of the hour.

wind_direction_deg.title: Wind Direction Deg
wind_direction_deg.description: Perseverance only. Azimuth in degrees clockwise from north as the source gives it (not stated whether from or to); centre of a 22.5 degree sector.

WeatherHour.title: WeatherHour
WeatherHour.description: One hour of LMST: the mean of each parameter and the lowest and highest valid value.

wind.description: Perseverance only (absent for Curiosity); null outside sols 36-313.

ground_temp_c.description: Curiosity (REMS, measured); Perseverance (estimate from the MEDA TIRS brightness temperature, emissivity 1; absent when switched off).

uv_wm2.description: Curiosity only (the key is absent for Perseverance).

wind.description: Perseverance only (absent for Curiosity); null outside sols 36-313.

ground_temp_c.description: Curiosity (REMS, measured); Perseverance (estimate from the MEDA TIRS brightness temperature, emissivity 1; absent when switched off).

uv_wm2.description: Curiosity only (the key is absent for Perseverance).

direction_mode_deg.title: Direction Mode Deg
direction_mode_deg.description: Most frequent direction: azimuth in degrees clockwise from north as the source gives it (MEDA does not say whether it is where the wind blows from or to); centre of a 22.5 degree sector.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Optional API key (si_ and 32 letters or digits), used when the server has API keys enabled (otherwise ignored): the account limits apply instead of the per-IP ones. Also accepted as the api_key query parameter; the header wins. Wrong keys answer 401 invalid_api_key, revoked ones 401 api_key_revoked, blocked accounts 403 account_blocked.
